verifications.claim: Lowe's stores will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: stores will be closed on Sunday in observance of the Easter holiday (R1); closed all day on Easter 2026 ... Sunday, April 5 (R2); Lowe’s will close all stores on Easter Sunday, April 5 (R3)
verifications.reasoning: All references directly state Lowe's stores are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.

verifications.claim: Lowe's stores will reopen with normal business hours on Monday, April 6, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Doors will reopen on Monday, April 6, during normal business hours (R1); Stores will reopen the next day with regular hours (R3, after April 5)
verifications.reasoning: R1 explicitly states reopening on April 6 with normal hours; R3 confirms reopening next day (April 6) with regular hours; R2 confirms closure date but omits reopening.
